title: Social Bias in Multilingual Language Models: A Survey
findings: The survey identifies religion as one of the social dimensions along which bias is measured in multilingual and non-English models. It is noted as a less frequently studied dimension compared to gender. The paper situates religious bias within the broader landscape of multilingual bias evaluation without providing specific model performance results.
